EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART IV (A) - PROVINCIAL COUNCILS
CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Hon. Governor - Central Province

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 154E(5) of the 13th amendment of the Constitution of Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka, I, E. M. Niluka Sandaruwani Ekanayake, Governor, Central Province do hereby notified that I madethe following appointments with effect from 2nd May, 2017.
Hon. Thennekoon Mudiyanselage Thilina Bandara Thennekoon
As the Minister of Sports, Youth Affairs, Womens’ Affairs, Rural Development and Industries of the CentralProvince.

By virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 154E(5) of the 13th amendement to the Constitution ofDemocratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, I, E. M. Niluka Sandaruwani Ekanayake, Governor, Central Province do herebynotified that I made the following appointments with effect from 3rd May, 2017. (According to the Cabinet decisions on03.05.2017 amendments made to the subjects of the Ministries of the Central Province)
Hon. Sarath Ekanayake

Chief Ministry of the Central Province, Minister of Finance and Planning, Law and Order, Local Governmentand Provincial Administration, Manpower, Education and Cultural Affairs, Tourism, Lands, Co-operativeDevelopment, Trade and Commerce, Food Supplies and Distribution Affairs, Environmental Affairs andInvestment Co-ordination and the subjects which are not taken under other Ministries.
Hon. M. Rameshwaran

Minister of Agriculture, Minor Irrigation, Animal Production and Development, Agrarian Development, Fisheries,Hindu Cultural Affairs, Tamil Education (Except Muslim Schools) and Estate Infrastructure Facilities in theCentral Province.
E. M. NILUKA SANDARUWANI EKANAYAKE,Governor - Central Province.
